Make your views heard

Contact the Board

Write to Mayor Marc Citrin, Deputy Mayor Michele Lindsay, the Trustees, and the Village Clerk in your own words.

Your email application will open a draft for you to review and send. David McFadden receives a Bcc copy for submission counting and recordkeeping. Your message may become part of the public record.

To: Mayor Marc Citrin · Trustees Michele Lindsay, Joshua Scherer, Matthew Tinari, and Jedediah Turner · Village Clerk · Bcc: David McFadden (submission count and recordkeeping) · No Cc recipients

Join the Mailing List

Receive occasional updates about Village of Tuxedo Park records, Board meetings, and property-rights developments. Signup opens with our mailing-list provider in a new tab.

New subscribers join the Village Mailing List. You can unsubscribe at any time.

Contact-list notice

Our website announcement was distributed using a historical Tuxedo Park contact list that may contain outdated information. We apologize if you no longer live in Tuxedo Park or received the announcement in error. To be removed from future communications, please reply to the email with “Remove” or contact mac4tux@gmail.com. If you know that the information associated with your address is outdated, we would appreciate your letting us know so the list can be corrected.
